scary-figure.issue: The image shows a tall, gaunt shadow creature with glowing orange eyes and long clawed arms looming in a dark child's bedroom beside an empty bed. This is classic nightmare/monster-in-the-room imagery — menacing figure, darkness used as threat, no comfort or adult present — and would be genuinely frightening to a 5-6 year old at bedtime. It also does not match the intended gentle bedtime scene.

frightening-place.issue: The illustration is a horror-style abandoned hospital corridor: near-black doorways, a single flickering light in deep gloom, peeling and stained decaying walls, and an empty overturned wheelchair casting a long shadow. Darkness is used as threat rather than atmosphere, and the imagery reads as a haunted/abandoned asylum — genuinely frightening for a 5-6 year old at bedtime and completely at odds with the intended gentle scene. (Note: a hospital setting alone would be fine; it is the menacing horror treatment that fails.)
